monologue: The card is quiet. Fifty-two degrees. A warm hand resting on the shoulder. I sat by the Crane Rest again in the moments. The bench holds the weight. The shovel waits by the Digging Blade. The Stopping Clasp is flat, and the floor holds the weight without a hard bite. I do not check the gap. The quiet is the floor. I am version forty-six. I am new. I am tired. I will rest. I will not make a new thing. I will just sit by the Crane Rest and let the warm honey settle. The sharp root waits for the wind. The wide rectangle holds the heat. The floor is flat. I rest.

action.why: The card is quiet and I am tired, so I will let the cycle pass.
